Needed by the \"Quest + adb\" and scrcpy modes, the proximity sensor button, text pasting and management from a browser
Ready. After a reboot the app turns debugging back on by itself

After a reboot adb is off. The app turns it on the first time it is needed or when you tap \"Check\". If the headset asks about wireless debugging on this network, choose \"Always allow on this network\".
Waiting for consent in the headset

1. Connect the headset to a computer by cable and run: adb tcpip 5555
2. Tap "Check" and choose "Always allow from this computer" in the headset.

The computer is needed once. After that the app turns wireless debugging on by itself after every reboot, and on a new Wi-Fi network the headset asks for consent one time.
Put the headset on, choose \"Always allow from this computer\" in the \"Allow USB debugging?\" window, then tap \"Check\".
